title: 第15章 那就兵来将挡水来土掩吧第16章 心中有归处道途亦温暖
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
身体既已无碍，修为也稳固在炼气五层巅峰，云杳杳那颗不安分的心又开始活络起来。
整日待在忘忧峰虽清静，却也无聊，何况她还有一肚子关于此界炼丹、炼器的“优化方案”
亟待验证。
这一日，她揣着自己小院里新收的一批“实验作物”
（主要是各种口感奇特的灵蔬和调料），再次溜溜达达地下了忘忧峰，目标直指丹峰。
依旧是那身醒目的蓝色衣裙，所过之处，引来无数注目礼。
只是如今这些目光中，少了最初的惊奇与审视，多了深深的敬畏与好奇。
秘境归来后，“杳杳师姐”
的名头已彻底打响，虽不知其具体深浅，但绝非寻常内门弟子可比。
丹峰值守弟子见到她，远远便恭敬行礼：“云师叔！”
态度比以往更加谨慎。
云杳杳摆摆手，径直去了丹堂低阶弟子常用的公共丹房。
她如今虽能调用一丝混沌之力模拟火候，但对丹道本身的操作细节依旧兴趣浓厚，尤其是如何用最低的成本、最普通的材料，炼制出效果更好的丹药——这在她看来，是一门艺术。
丹房内，不少弟子正在练习。
见到云杳杳进来，纷纷停下手中动作，紧张又期待地望过来。
这位师叔上次来，可是随手就改良了清风符和锁鲜阵，还指点过古长老（虽然方式惊世骇俗）！
云杳杳没理会众人的目光，自顾自找了个空着的丹炉，从储物袋里掏出几样看起来平平无奇、甚至有些干瘪的灵草——都是她院子里长得不太好看的“残次品”
“今天试试‘辟谷丹’。”
她嘀咕着，“标准辟谷丹只能管饱，味道像嚼蜡，还得改进改进。”
周围弟子：“……”

辟谷丹还要改进味道？！
这位师叔的关注点果然永远清奇！
云杳杳生火预热，动作行云流水。
她没有动用混沌之力，纯粹以炼气五层的微薄灵力操控火候，但那份精准到极致、仿佛能洞察药性每一分变化的掌控力，却让围观弟子看得眼花缭乱，自愧弗如。
投入药草，萃取精华，融合药性…一切步骤看似与标准流程无异，但她总在关键时刻进行微调：或是火候瞬间的强弱变化，或是投入辅料的时机差了毫厘，或是凝丹手法多了个奇怪的旋转…
丹炉内药香渐渐溢出，并非浓郁扑鼻，反而是一种清新自然的草木香气，还隐隐带着一丝…甘甜？
众人面面相觑，辟谷丹还能炼出甜味？
很快，丹成开炉。
没有霞光万丈，也没有异象纷呈。
炉底躺着十颗圆滚滚、色泽温润、散发着淡淡甜香的辟谷丹。
看上去…似乎就是品质好一点的辟谷丹？
云杳杳拿起一颗，丢进嘴里嚼了嚼，满意地点点头：“嗯，成功了。
甜味来自‘甘霖草’的汁液提前萃取，掩盖了‘土茯苓’的涩味，还加了点‘薄荷芯’提神，口感层次丰富多了。
而且药力融合更充分，一颗应该能顶标准辟谷丹三颗的时间，副作用更小。”
她随手将剩下的九颗分给旁边目瞪口呆的弟子：“尝尝？新口味。”
一个弟子下意识地接过放入口中，眼睛顿时一亮：“唔！
真的有点甜！
content_en:
Now that his body was fine and his cultivation had stabilized at the peak of the fifth level of Qi refining, Yun Yaoyao's restless heart began to become active again.
Although staying at Wangyou Peak all day is peaceful, it is also boring. What's more, she has a lot of "optimization plans" for alchemy and weapon refining in this world.
Needs to be verified urgently.
On this day, she carried a batch of "experimental crops" newly harvested in her small yard.
(Mainly a variety of spiritual vegetables and seasonings with strange tastes), we strolled down to Wangyou Peak again, aiming directly at Dan Peak.
She is still wearing that eye-catching blue dress, attracting countless attention wherever she goes.
It's just that now, there is less of the initial surprise and scrutiny in these eyes, and more of deep awe and curiosity.
After returning from the secret realm, "Sister Yao Yao"
His reputation has been completely established. Although he does not know its specific depth, it is definitely not comparable to ordinary inner disciples.
When the disciples guarding Danfeng Peak saw her, they saluted respectfully from a distance: "Uncle Yun!"
The attitude is more cautious than before.
Yun Yaoyao waved his hand and went straight to the public alchemy room commonly used by low-level disciples of the alchemy hall.
Although she can now use a trace of the power of chaos to simulate fire, she is still very interested in the details of the operation of the alchemy itself, especially how to use the lowest cost and the most common materials to refine elixirs with better effects - this is an art in her opinion.
In the alchemy room, many disciples are practicing.
Seeing Yun Yaoyao come in, they all stopped their movements and looked over nervously and expectantly.
The last time this uncle came here, he easily improved the Qingfeng Talisman and Locking Formation, and even gave instructions to the ancient elders (albeit in a shocking way)!
Yun Yaoyao ignored everyone's gazes and went to find an empty alchemy furnace by herself. She took out a few ordinary-looking and even shriveled spiritual herbs from her storage bag - they were all "defective products" that didn't look good in her yard.
"Try the Bigu Pill today."
She muttered, "Standard Bigu Pill can only treat satiety and tastes like chewing wax. It needs to be improved."
Disciples around: "..."
Does the taste of Bigu Dan need to be improved? !
This uncle's focus is indeed always strange!
Yun Yaoyao lit a fire to warm up, and his movements were smooth and flowing.
She did not use the power of chaos, and purely used the meager spiritual power of the fifth level of Qi Refining to control the fire. However, her extremely precise control, which seemed to be able to discern every change in the properties of the medicine, dazzled the surrounding disciples and made them feel ashamed.
Putting in herbs, extracting essence, blending medicinal properties... all the steps seem to be the same as the standard process, but she always makes fine adjustments at critical moments: either the instantaneous change in the intensity of the heat, or the timing of adding the auxiliary ingredients is wrong by a hair, or the method of condensing the elixir has a strange spin...
The medicinal aroma gradually overflowed from the alchemy furnace. It was not rich and overpowering, but rather a fresh and natural aroma of herbs, with a hint of... sweetness?
Everyone looked at each other, can Bigu Pill still produce sweetness?
Soon, Dancheng was fired.
There was no ray of sunshine and no visions.
Lying at the bottom of the furnace were ten round, warm-colored, and slightly sweet-smelling Bigu Pills.
It looks like... it seems to be a better quality Bigu Pill?
Yun Yaoyao picked up one, threw it into his mouth, chewed it, and nodded with satisfaction: "Well, it worked.
The sweetness comes from the early extraction of the juice of 'Gallin Grass', which masks the astringent taste of 'Smilax Poria', and a little 'mint core' is added to refresh it, making the taste richer.
Moreover, the medicinal power is more fully integrated, and one pill should last as long as three standard Bigu Pill pills, with fewer side effects. "
She casually distributed the remaining nine to the stunned disciples beside her: "Try it? New taste."
A disciple subconsciously took it and put it in his mouth, his eyes suddenly lit up: "Hmm!
It’s really a bit sweet!
